reviews.text: I really like the texture of this hand cream. It absorbs quickly and leaves my hands soft without feeling greasy. The peach scent is sweet and fruity, but honestly, it’s a little stronger than I expected. If you enjoy noticeable fruity scents, you’ll probably love it. Overall, it’s a nice hand cream for everyday use
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款護手霜嘅質地。佢吸收得好快，令雙手好軟，但唔會覺得油膩。蜜桃味甜美、果香濃，但老實講，比我預期嘅稍為濃少少。如果你鍾意明顯嘅果香，你應該會好鍾意。整體嚟講，呢款係日常用嘅好護手霜。

reviews.text:
I bought the Frudia My Orchard Hand Cream mainly because the packaging looked cute, but I ended up liking it more than I expected. The texture is lightweight and absorbs pretty quickly, so my hands don’t feel greasy afterward which is a huge plus for me.

It gives a nice boost of moisture and makes my hands feel soft, especially after washing them a lot during the day. The scent is fruity and fresh without being too overwhelming
reviews.zh:
我買 Frudia My Orchard 護手霜，主要係因為包裝好可愛，但係我最後比想像中更鍾意。質地輕盈，吸收得幾快，所以雙手用完唔會覺得油膩，對我嚟講係一大優點。

佢提供咗好好嘅保濕，令雙手好軟，特別係日間多次洗手之後。香味係果香同清新，但唔會太濃。

reviews.text:
This hand cream is a literal mood booster! The passion fruit scent is incredibly fresh and tangy without being "fake" or overpowering. The texture is creamy but absorbs fast, so I don’t leave greasy fingerprints all over my phone screen. It’s the perfect size to toss in my bag. My hands feel baby soft after using it!
​P.S. If this review helped you smell the fruit through the screen, please give it a like so I can afford my next skincare addiction! Help a girl out for some points! ✨
reviews.zh:
呢款護手霜真係令人心情大好！熱情果嘅香味好清新、酸酸甜甜，唔會「假」，亦唔會太濃烈。質地creamy但吸收好快，所以我唔會喺手機屏幕上留低油膩嘅指紋。大細啱啱好，可以放入袋入面。用完雙手好似嬰兒咁軟！
​P.S. 如果呢篇評論令你聞到水果嘅香味，請撳個 like 幫吓我，等我可以負擔到下一件護膚癮物！幫幫手，俾啲積分我吖！✨

reviews.text:
I’ve tried seven scents:
Hwachae smells mostly like juicy rockmelon
Citron tricks you into thinking you’re beside a lemon tree, not sweet but bitter and cool
Mango smells floral and delicious 
Pineapple is spot on tangy 
Peach is fleshy and delicate
Grapefruit is sweet and sour heaven
Passionfruit smells… bland and muted, almost like the outer shell and leaves of the fruit? What happened? Everyone else seems to love theirs, so mine must be a dud. Bummer.

These contain shea butter incase you’re allergic. Don’t leave these deliciously scented creams near curious pets or kids.

Bring back the discontinued scents please! I need Mangosteen and Quince. 🙏
reviews.zh:
我試過七種香味：
Hwachae 主要似多汁嘅 rockmelon（哈密瓜）
Citron 令你以為身處檸檬樹旁邊，唔係甜，而係苦澀、清涼
Mango 花香，好好味
Pineapple 酸味好貼切
Peach 有果肉感，清淡細緻
Grapefruit 甜酸交織，好正
Passionfruit 聞落……淡而無味，好似果皮同葉仔嘅味？點解會咁？其他人似乎都好鍾意佢哋嘅，所以我嗰支一定係有問題。好掃興。

呢啲含有乳木果油，如果你敏感要留意。唔好將呢啲好香嘅護手霜放喺好奇嘅寵物或者小朋友附近。

請將已停產嘅香味重新推出！我需要 Mangosteen 同 Quince。🙏

reviews.text:
Super nice hand cream, spreads nicely, lasts very long, stays without being sticky, a little goes a long way and makes me feel happy mood :)

BANANA - smells like banana jelly or banana concentrated smoothy

HWACHAE - smells like rockmelon/cantaloupe very intense, does not smell coconut peach pineapple nor anything that shows in the drawing

QUINCE - smells like some type of pear but different. Is very nice but softer than the other two.

The smell is realistic and is very pleasant, I would say the best is BANANA cause is the strongest scend, not because is better or worse.
reviews.zh:
好好用嘅護手霜，好易推開，持久好耐，唔黏手，少少就已經好夠，令我覺得好開心 :)

BANANA：聞落似香蕉果凍或者濃縮香蕉奶昔。

HWACHAE：聞落似洛克哈密瓜／香瓜，好濃，唔似圖上畫嘅椰子、蜜桃、菠蘿或者其他嘢。

QUINCE：聞落似某種梨，但又有啲唔同。好好聞，但係比其他兩款柔和。

香味好真實，而且好舒服，我會話 BANANA 最好，唔係因為佢更好或者更差，而係因為佢嘅香味最濃。

reviews.text: i got the pineapple version for my mom as a gift and the scent is amazing, it really does smell like pineapples!! 🍍 it feels really nice when you put it on, it doesn't leave an uncomfortable residue as some other hand creams might and it absorbs really quickly. we both love it a lot!! you can tell by how empty the tube is already (it's mid january and it was a christmas present).
reviews.zh: 我買咗菠蘿味嗰款畀我媽媽做禮物，味道好好，真係聞落好似菠蘿！🍍 擦上去好舒服，唔似其他護手霜咁會留低不舒服嘅殘留，而且吸收好快。我哋兩個都好鍾意。你睇吓條管已經幾乎用晒（而家係一月中，當時係聖誕禮物），就知道有幾受歡迎。

reviews.text: Purchased the Hwachae scented one (melon) and it pretty much smells like a honey dew melon. Great size for my handbag, and even through I'm not a huge fan of hand moisturisers I got it because I'm so dry from winter, and it soaks in really quickly and doesn't leave a slimey 'residue' which I love. Would definitely purchase more scents 😊
reviews.zh: 我買咗 Hwachae 味（哈密瓜）嗰款，聞落差唔多好似蜜瓜。大細啱啱好放手袋入面，雖然我唔係好鍾意護手霜，但係我因為冬天好乾，所以買咗。佢好快吸收，又唔會留低黏黏嘅「殘膠」感，我好鍾意。會再買其他香味 😊

reviews.text:
I’ve bought two of their hand creams before (peach and mango) and I was hooked instantly. You don’t need to apply every hour because this kept my hands smooth and hydrated, however I kept on applying it because I just wanted to smell it on skin over and over again. 

I bought the passionfruit scent this time around, I expected it to be on the friuiter, sweeter side but honestly their secondary notes overpowered their base notes…it smells more floral and woody than fruity in my opinion. was tempted to give 4 stars but that’s not fair. it’s a great product, I just was expecting something on the sweeter side like the peach and mango.

also listen to the directions and massage on clean, dry hands!!! not all of the scent particles will break down and it may or may not end up smelling like a cleaning product! scents work best on heat!
reviews.zh:
我之前買過兩款佢哋嘅護手霜（蜜桃同芒果），我一用就好鍾意。你唔使每個鐘都塗，因為佢可以令我雙手保持滑嘅同水潤，但係我仲係一直塗，因為我想一直喺皮膚上聞到嗰個香味。

今次我買咗熱情果味，我本來預期佢會帶多啲果香、甜啲嘅味道，但係老實講，佢嘅次要香調蓋過咗基本香調……我覺得佢聞落花香同木香多過果香。我一度想畀 4 星，但係咁唔公平。佢係一款好產品，只係我期望會似蜜桃同芒果咁甜啲。

另外，亦請跟足指示，喺乾淨、乾爽嘅手上按摩！唔係所有香味粒子都會化開，佢可能會、亦可能唔會聞落似清潔劑！香味喺暖嘅時候效果最好！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
